notes.text: Baijiahao article publishing for build-in-public posts uses heterogeneous editors: title is Lexical-style, body is UEditor inside iframe, and publish often requires both cover and source declaration before the button really works.
Reliable completion check is not just the submit success page; always open content management and confirm the title row shows publish time and status 已发布.

workflows.name: Publish Baijiahao build-in-public article
workflows.description: Publish a long-form progress report on Baijiahao with AI cover and source declaration completed.
steps: Fill the Lexical title editor with the final article title.
Set the UEditor iframe body content with the long-form article text.
Open cover settings and use AI封图, then confirm until the main page shows 编辑 / 更换.
Open 创作声明, enable 来源说明, then fill time and place before publishing.
Trigger publish, then verify first on the submit success page and finally in 内容管理 where the title row must show publish time and 已发布.
